purpose: Canonical modern-life manifestation vocabulary. Existing astrology calculations remain the source of truth; this table maps validated manifestations to human-readable meaning.
principles: Do not infer a manifestation unless its required evidence is present.
Age changes the manifestation context, not only the wording.
Same cohesion group is one user-facing story within a life area.
Specific events require stronger evidence than broad patterns.
Health entries are wellbeing interpretations, not medical diagnoses or outcomes.
